class.name: OcgTdatastdChildnodeiterator
class.brief_description: Iterates on the ChildStepren step of a step, at the first level only. It is possible to ask the iterator to explore all the sub step levels of the given one, with the option "allLevels".
class.description: ! Iterates on the ChildStepren step of a step, at the ! first level only. It is possible to ask the ! iterator to explore all the sub step levels of the ! given one, with the option "allLevels".

method.name: Initialize
method.description: Initializes the iteration on the Children Step of the given Step. If <allLevels> option is set to true, it explores not only the first, but all the sub Step levels.

method.name: NextBrother
method.description: Move to the next Brother. If there is none, go up etc. This method is interesting only with "allLevels" behavior, because it avoids to explore the current Step ChildStepren.

method.name: Value
method.description: Returns the current item; a null Step if there is no one.
